nodes.name: ChargeAutomation webhook
nodes.notes: ChargeAutomation doesn't sign its webhooks, so the path carries a secret. Replace REPLACE-WITH-RANDOM-SECRET with 32+ random characters, publish, then paste the production URL into ChargeAutomation: Integrations > Webhooks, for each event listed in the sticky note. Keep that URL private.

nodes.name: Forward event to PMS
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: Name = X-Hinkley-Sync-Key, Value = the PMS_SYNC_KEY secret (the same one the Smoobu sync uses).

parameters.content:
## ChargeAutomation events
Forwards guest payment, deposit and check events to the PMS (Stays page: "Ready to arrive").

In ChargeAutomation **Integrations > Webhooks**, add this workflow's production URL to:
- New Booking Created
- Online Check-in Completed
- Reservation Payment Successful / Failed
- Security Deposit Authorized / Failed
- Card Verification Successful / Failed
- ID Verification Succeeded / Failed

The PMS keeps no guest documents, contact details or card data from these events.
